method: scripts/compare_delphi_rtl.py: map-bounded blocks of 32..2048 bytes with at least 24 fixed bytes, unique in the reference. PE HIGHLOW relocations and external rel32 operands are masked; internal branches and ordinary constants are retained. Direct call/jump endpoints are checked where both endpoints are mapped. Three TControl VMT slots independently anchor the comparisons.
limitations: This is a normalized-byte identity inventory, not proof that every relocation or data operand has the correct semantic target.
A MAP span can include alignment or embedded data.
Only unique target matches are included; absent and ambiguous reference blocks remain unassigned.
